# agyn_app_installation (Resource)

Manages an Agyn app installation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "agyn_organization" "example" {
  name = "example-org"
}

resource "agyn_app" "example" {
  organization_id = agyn_organization.example.id
  slug            = "example-app"
  name            = "Example App"
  visibility      = "internal"
}

resource "agyn_app_installation" "example" {
  app_id          = agyn_app.example.id
  organization_id = agyn_organization.example.id
  slug            = "example-installation"
  configuration = jsonencode({
    workspace = "default"
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App identifier.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization identifier.
- `slug` (String) Installation slug.

### Optional

- `configuration` (String) JSON configuration for the installation.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID identifier of the installation.
